messages:
katie_sales: FYI — SpectraIO is blocking the POC start. Two asks from their side: exec signoff on a nonstandard discount + IP allowlist for our hosted endpoints. CISO flagged network peering questions. Can we triage?

mira_se: what discount % are they asking for and for how long? also which endpoints need whitelisting (region)?

katie_sales: they're asking 40% off list for a 3-month committed POC. want EU-only traffic and an allowlist for 3 CIDR blocks they will provide. also asked about dedicated capacity option during POC.

ryan_eng: we can spin an EU sandbox cluster behind dedicated capacity, but need infra ticket + exact IP ranges. QPS estimates? if sustained load > 200 rps we need to size GPUs differently.

jack_cust_success: customer says expected steady-state 120 rps with spikes to ~350 for short periods (batch onboarding). they're ok with canary throttling.

elena_ciso: I need the data flow diagram (DFD) + where tokens/keys are stored. if any PII passes through, we need KMS/HSM controls and audit logging. also SAML metadata for SSO.

katie_sales: noted. they signed our NDA already. legal sent initial redlines, nothing major except data-residency clause — they want EU data residency for logs.

ryan_eng: infra provision command (we can reuse for the POC):

```
redwood infra provision --cluster eu-poc-01 --capacity dedicated --gpus a10x8 --saml true --ip-allowlist "10.12.0.0/22, 52.41.128.0/27, 18.204.0.0/24"
```

ryan_eng: I'll need a ticket to actually run this and a PO if we're doing reserved capacity.

ops_bot: created ticket RW-8732 (provision eu-poc-01 dedicated cluster) — assignee: ryan_eng — ETA: 48h

mira_se: I'll pull together a short one-pager for SpectraIO covering: architecture diagram, SSO/SAML flow, keys handling, and expected performance. assigning myself to coordinate.

katie_sales: thanks Mira. quick ask — the exec wants to know if Tim (CEO) needs to sign off on this discount or can we approve at VP sales level?

tim_ceo: don't sign anything that sets a precedent. let sales propose discount as a time-limited POC concession and include clear termination + no-commit renewal clause. I'll sign if legal approves wording and engineering confirms capacity/cost impact.

elena_ciso: also need to see SOC2 cert excerpt and our data-processing addendum applied to the POC contract. if logs stay in EU, fine. share link to SOC2 upload.

jack_cust_success: SpectraIO says they can accept SOC2 attestation and DPA. pinged them for full CIDR list + SAML metadata by EOD.

mira_se: plan: 1) DFD + SAML metadata by EOD tomorrow, 2) infra ticket in progress (RW-8732), 3) cost impact summary for finance by EOD as well. who owns legal redlines? katie_sales?

katie_sales: legal own this, I'm looping in legal now. I'll paste legal contact and ask for expedited review.

ryan_eng: one technical note — if we do IP allowlist on hosted endpoints we need to coordinate with edge routing team; that can add ~6-12 hours work. if they accept IPsec peering instead might be cleaner but more heavyweight.

elena_ciso: prefer peering or customer-side allowlist only. no permanent broad allowlists. temporary POC allowlist ok if limited and logged.

jack_cust_success: SpectraIO prefers allowlist, but open to short-lived peering. will confirm.

katie_sales: summarizing owners: Mira = coord + deliverables, Ryan = infra + sizing, Elena = security signoff, Legal = contract redlines, Tim = exec sign off if legal + eng OK. I'll keep sales thread updated.

mira_se: I'll follow up with status in this thread and create a calendar invite for sync once we have CIDRs and SOC2 doc. moving infra updates to #release-war-room and will reference RW-8732.

katie_sales: thanks all — marking this as high priority. SpectraIO wants kickoff by next Wed. ETA check: can we meet that?

ryan_eng: provision ETA 48h after ticket is triaged. if legal delays, kickoff slips.

mira_se: aiming for next Wed, will escalate if any blocker appears.

ops_bot: ticket RW-8732 updated: status=triaged, assignee=ryan_eng, created=1835001302

mira_se: I'll post the DFD draft here when ready.

katie_sales: great — thanks team :thumbsup:
